Class CardGUI

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.StackPane
it.polimi.ingsw.client.ui.gui.PopupPane
it.polimi.ingsw.client.ui.gui.CardGUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class CardGUI extends PopupPane
JavaFX component that represents a game card in the GUI. Extends PopupPane to provide a tooltip with the card's name and description on hover. Each instance displays the card image (front or back), supports flipping, an animated golden highlight for selectable cards, and a sliding animation when the card belongs to the character row.

    • setHighlight

      public void setHighlight(boolean highlighted)
      Shows or hides the animated selection highlight on this card. When enabled, a pulsing golden border is displayed over the card image to indicate that the card is selectable by the player.
      Parameters:
      highlighted - true to show the highlight, false to hide it

    • showSliding

      public void showSliding(javafx.scene.layout.HBox charRow, javafx.scene.layout.HBox buildEvRow)
      Attaches mouse hover handlers that trigger a sliding animation when this card is hovered in the character row. On hover, cards to the left slide further left, this card slides right to become fully visible, and all cards in the building and event row shift right to make room. On exit, all translations are reset.
      Parameters:
      charRow - the HBox containing the character cards
      buildEvRow - the HBox containing the building and event cards
